properties.name: Brawn
properties.description: Raw physical force. Every attack here rolls 1d20 plus the attacker's brawn.

properties.name: Grit
properties.description: How much punishment a patron shrugs off before the room starts spinning. By default a patron holds up to 3 plus their grit in drink.

properties.name: Footing
properties.description: How hard a patron is to knock off balance. Every attack here rolls against the target's footing.

properties.name: Drink
properties.description: How much ale has ended up on or in a patron, by default up to 3 plus their grit. While any is left the patron is dazed by ale; sobering up drains it to nothing, which clears the daze.

properties.name: Stamina
properties.description: How many big, showy moves a patron has left this scene, 2 by default. A chair swing spends one, and nothing here restores it.
